root_cause.text: The length validation check in rxgk_verify_response() is inverted (auth_len < len instead of auth_len > len), allowing an oversized authenticator length to bypass validation and trigger a BUG_ON in skb_to_sgvec().
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the condition from `if (auth_len < len)` to `if (auth_len > len)`, and the commit message states: "The existing check is inverted, so oversized RESPONSE authenticators are accepted and passed to rxgk_decrypt_skb(), which can later reach skb_to_sgvec() with an impossible length and hit BUG_ON(len)."
